definitions.explanation: A pitch thrown at high speed in baseball. The most basic and common type of pitch.

examples.japanese: {速球|そっきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げた→投げる：01135_nageru⟧。
⟦バッター→バッター：27284_battaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{速球|そっきゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}り→振る：01983_furu⟧⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦{三振|さんしん}→三振：08588_sanshin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The batter swung late on the fastball and struck out.

notes:
USAGE:
A baseball term. Japan measures pitch speed in kilometers per hour (⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧). A fastball over 150 km/h (~93 mph) is considered very fast. Opposite of ⟦{変化球|へんかきゅう}→変化球：17367_henkakyuu⟧ (breaking ball).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速球|そっきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧: to throw a fastball
- {速球|そっきゅう}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧: power pitcher (fastball-oriented)
- {剛速球|ごうそっきゅう}: blazing fastball
- {速球|そっきゅう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{変化球|へんかきゅう}→変化球：17367_henkakyuu⟧: fastballs and breaking balls
